title: Classes & Objects
explanation: A class is a blueprint; an object is an instance of it. Fields hold an object's data, a constructor sets it up, and methods define its behavior.
From this lesson on, the static Playground class is available to your code -- it's your bridge to the actual world around you in-game. Try Playground.say(...) and Playground.placeBlock(...) below.
Positions are relative to you: Playground.placeBlock(dx, dy, dz, "stone") places a block dx/dy/dz away from where you're standing.
